description:
Identification - 
- Commonly known as a Common House Spider
- Scientific name is Achaearanea tepidariorum and is part of Kingdom Plantae 

Visual Description - 
- The spider is yellowish brown with a dirty white abdomen and many dark stripes meeting at an angle. 
- Males are 3/16 in long and Females are about 5/16 in long. 
- A shared characteristic between the species is having 8 legs. 

Location and Habitat - 
-  I found this insect by a park near my house called Davis Park in Brandon, FL (Lat: 27.9487, Long: -82.286824). 
- This spider is found all throughout the US and Canada and mostly lives indoors in its webs. 

References - 
- https://www.pestworld.org/pest-guide/spiders/house-spiders/
